career_ladder.note: Sub-Inspectors (SI) in Haryana Police are recruited directly for both Male and Female cadres as investigation officers and station house officers. Promotions through the executive police cadre are governed by the Punjab Police Rules (1934, as applicable to Haryana) and Haryana Police Act, 2007.

steps.source_label: HSSC Advt No. 03/2021 (Recruitment of 465 Sub-Inspectors) & Haryana Civil Services Rules

steps.years: approx. 6-10 yrs (subject to Upper School Course and state merit list)
steps.source_label: Haryana Police Service Cadre & Promotion Rules

steps.years: approx. 14-18 yrs (induction into Haryana Police Service - State Gazetted Rank)

steps.source_label: State Police Service Senior Scale Promotion Rules

steps.designation: Superintendent of Police (Selection Grade / IPS Conferred)
steps.source_label: Indian Police Service (Appointment by Promotion) Regulations

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Haryana Police Sub-Inspector comprises a Knowledge Test (80 marks), Physical Screening Test (PST - qualifying), Physical Measurement Test (PMT - qualifying), followed by Scrutiny of Documents with additional qualification weightage (up to 20 marks).

stages.source_label: HSSC Advt 03/2021 Scheme of Examination for Sub-Inspector (Male & Female)

papers.paper_name: Objective Knowledge Test — General Studies, Current Affairs, General Science, Reasoning, Mental Aptitude, Numerical Ability, Agriculture, Animal Husbandry, Basic Computer Knowledge (min. 10 questions), and Basic Criminal Law
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (100 questions of 0.80 marks each)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Competitive merit threshold to qualify for PST/PMT (approx. 7 times vacancies)

stages.source_label: Haryana Police Physical Screening Test Criteria

papers.paper_name: Running Endurance Test (Male: 2.5 km in 12 min; Female: 1.0 km in 6 min; Ex-Servicemen: 1.0 km in 5 min with RFID chip)

stages.source_label: Haryana Police Physical Measurement Test Criteria

papers.paper_name: Physical Standards (Male: Height 170 cm Gen / 168 cm Res, Chest 83 cm + 4 cm expansion; Female: Height 158 cm Gen / 156 cm Res)
Weightage for Higher Education (Degree in Law / MCA / M.Sc. CS / Post Graduation: max 7 marks) and NCC Certification (max 3 marks: C=3, B=2, A=1)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Award of additional marks contributing to final merit list

financial_package.note: Sub-Inspectors in Haryana Police are remunerated in Functional Pay Level 6 (FPL-6) under Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016, with entry basic pay of ₹35,400.
financial_package.pay_source_label: HSSC Advt 03/2021 & Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016 (Scale ₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on entry Level 6 basic pay of ₹35,400 with 58% Dearness Allowance (₹20,532), House Rent Allowance (8% to 24%), uniform allowance, special police conveyance allowance, and ration subsidy, minus standard deductions.
official_perks: House Rent Allowance (HRA) or designated official police quarter accommodation
Uniform maintenance allowance and kit allowance
Cashless Medical Scheme under Government of Haryana
New Pension Scheme (NPS) with state government matching contribution

competition_benchmarks.note: Sub-Inspector recruitment in Haryana Police is highly selective, attracting graduates, post-graduates, and law professionals from across Haryana and neighboring states.

years.source_label: HSSC Advt 03/2021: 465 vacancies (400 Male SI, 65 Female SI); over 1.52 lakh registered applicants; 1.10 lakh appeared in written exam on September 26, 2021.

official_downloads.note: Official notifications, examination schedules, admit cards, and selection lists are published on HSSC and Haryana Police web portals.
